newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 1,500 METRES CHAMPION SACRAMENTO.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 1,500 METRES CHAMPION SACRAMENTO.

text.p: Profile of Carla Sacramento, winner of the world women's 1,500 metres on Tuesday.
Part of the new wave of Portuguese women's middle distance running along with Fernanda Ribeiro, she has steadily improved since reaching the semifinal of the Barcelona Olympics in 1992.
Took the silver in the world champiopnships in Gothenburg two years ago and was sixth in the Olympics last year.
Looked impressive winning the mile in Nice last month in four minutes 25.00 seconds, fastest time of the year.
